news.title: Pinto scores the shootout winner to send the Senators to a 2-1 victory over the Islanders

news.description: — Shane Pinto scored the shootout winner to lead the Ottawa Senators to a 2-1 win over the New York Islanders on Thursday night.

news.title: Red Wings send Flyers to franchise record-extending 9th straight loss to start season
news.ruTitle: «Ред Уингз» отправили «Флайерз» в франшизу с рекордным девятым поражением подряд в начале сезона
news.description: — Andrew Copp broke a tie with 4:38 left and the Detroit Red Wings sent the Philadelphia Flyers to their franchise record-extending ninth straight loss to start the season, winning 2-1 on Thursday night.

news.title: Owen Power scores in OT to complete Sabres' rally for 5-4 win over Maple Leafs
news.ruTitle: Оуэн Пауэр забивает в овертайме и завершает розыгрыш «Сэйбрз» над победой над «Мэйпл Лифс» со счетом 5–4.
news.description: — Owen Power scored in overtime and the Buffalo Sabres rallied from two goals down in the third period to overcome Kirill Marchenko's hat trick and beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 5-4 on Thursday.

news.description: — Captain Victor Hedman scored just over two minutes into overtime to give the Tampa Bay Lightning a 4-3 victory over the Seattle Kraken on Thursday...

news.title: Brady Tkachuk completes his 2nd straight natural hat trick in OT as Panthers stun Canucks

news.description: — Brady Tkachuk completed his second straight natural hat trick with a nifty move up the middle in overtime to give the Florida Panthers a 3-2 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday night.

news.title: Maple Leafs acquire Aatu Räty, send Jacob Quillan, Brandon Buhr to Canucks

news.title: Senators' William Eklund set to miss 10-12 weeks after ankle surgery
news.ruTitle: Сенатор Уильям Эклунд пропустит 10-12 недель после операции на лодыжке
news.description: Senators forward William Eklund is expected to be out 10 to 12 weeks after undergoing surgery to repair a torn tendon in his ankle suffered last week against the Flyers.

news.title: Arizona State hockey coach exits amid probe into collapse; Dave Hakstol hired

news.title: Stanley Cup odds: Flyers, Red Wings see futures tumble after lousy starts

news.title: After offseason chaos, the Red Wings have an 'us against the world' mentality
